comments.author: Donce
comments.body: I've managed to catch Blackfish closer to Europe, north west of Ireland. I was on my way back from Newfoundland and caught it at about (15500,2004) thus completing my Memorial album.

comments.author: Sanisjas
comments.body: Confirmed r6only in 15500,2004).put down your anchor then come back.take around 3min quite rare though

comments.author: Sanisjas
comments.body: Oh don't forget to put down your anchor or it can't swim to your ship in time if u fish while sail.lol

comments.author: DBravo
comments.body: Can also be caught in South Greenland Sea 14500:1350. Blackfish is a Memorial Album discovery in the Edible Fish and Fish Eggs album
